title: ResearchFlow-Eval: Tracing the Execution Gap in End-to-End Multi-Claim Autoresearch
abstract: arXiv:2610.18088v2 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Autoresearch systems increasingly undertake entire research projects. In practice, scientific research requires systems to pursue multiple interdependent claims through a continuous, multi-stage workflow and revise experiments as evidence accumulates. Existing evaluations of autoresearch systems, however, typically score isolated tasks or final artifacts, leaving these process-level capabilities largely unmeasured. We therefore introduce ResearchFlow-Eval, a fine-grained framework for assessing continuous scientific execution and iteration at both the stage and claim levels. Each evaluation is grounded in a published anchor paper, from which we derive stage-specific rubrics that decompose each research stage into dimensions and separately scored rubric items. translated_title: ResearchFlow-Eval：追踪端到端多论断自主研究中的执行差距
translated_abstract: 自主研究系统越来越多地承担起完整的研究项目。在实践中，科学研究要求系统通过持续的、多阶段的工作流程来追求多个相互依赖的论断，并随着证据的积累不断修订实验。然而，现有的自主研究系统评估通常只对孤立任务或最终成果进行打分，使得这些过程层面的能力在很大程度上未被衡量。因此，我们提出了 ResearchFlow-Eval，这是一个在阶段与论断两个层面上评估持续科学执行与迭代的细粒度框架。每项评估都锚定于一篇已发表的论文，从中推导出针对各阶段的评分细则，将每个研究阶段分解为多个维度和分别打分的细则条目。利用这些评分细则，我们对每个研究阶段进行评分，并详细考察实验执行情况，重点关注多论断的完成度以及跨多次尝试的修订。我们将该评估应用于（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出 ResearchFlow-Eval——一个基于已发表论文锚定、在阶段与论断两个层面细粒度评估端到端多论断自主研究系统持续科学执行与迭代能力的评测框架，弥补了现有评估仅打分孤立任务或最终成果的不足。
en_tdlr: We introduce ResearchFlow-Eval, a fine-grained framework anchored in published papers that evaluates continuous scientific execution and iteration of end-to-end multi-claim autoresearch systems at both the stage and claim levels, addressing the gap left by evaluations that only score isolated tasks or final artifacts.
